neighbours.label: DNS name-server vocabulary: tokens of 'name server(s)', 'NS record', 'IP address' in text about domains and DNS (the + pole takes 'top-level domain(s)' / FQDN, the naming hierarchy side)
fire: After buying the domain, log in to the registrar and replace the default nameservers with the ones your host gave you.
The zone file lists two NS records, one for the primary name server and one for the secondary.
A resolver first asks a root name server, which refers it to the servers responsible for the zone.
If the lookup fails, check that the domain's name servers are answering and that the A record holds the right IP address.
Our hosting company runs four authoritative name servers, and every customer domain must list at least two of them.
Glue records are needed when the name servers for a domain sit inside that same domain.
The DNS change can take a day to spread, because caching name servers keep the old NS records until they expire.
To move the site, update the nameservers at the registrar so the domain resolves to the new IP address.
quiet: After buying the laptop, log in to the vendor's site and replace the default password with a stronger one of your own.
The spreadsheet lists two contacts, one for the main office and one for the warehouse.
A new employee first asks a team lead, who refers them to the person responsible for the project.
If the upload fails, check that the file is smaller than the limit and that the folder has the right permissions.
Our hosting company offers four pricing plans, and every customer must choose one of them at signup.
Extra licenses are needed when the designers for a project work outside that same office.
The redesign can take a month to finish, because the editors keep revising the old pages until they are happy.
To move the blog, export the posts from the old theme so the layout carries over to the new template.

notes: Card: ' NS', 'ervers', ' servers', ' IP' in DNS text. Probes: three DNS sentences 0.44-0.48, two non-DNS 0.01. Near misses stay in web/IT administration but avoid name servers, records and IP addresses.
